mali-request-final-record.receipt-7:
On 2023-XX, France and the UAE submitted S/2023/638 [status-638]. It proposed renewing sanctions and extending the Panel of Experts. The tally was 13 in favour, 1 against, and 1 abstention. Russia cast the sole negative vote. The draft failed because a permanent member voted against it. France supported it; China abstained. The UAE explained the draft aimed to support peace agreement implementation and orderly drawdown [french-uae].

Russia submitted S/2023/639 [status-639] as a separate draft. It proposed a final extension and immediate dissolution of the Panel. The tally was 1 in favour, 1 against, and 13 abstentions. Russia voted in favour; Japan voted against; all others abstained. The draft failed due to insufficient support. Russia argued the existing approach ignored Mali's transitional government concerns [russia]. France noted the veto and stated Russia's proposal was not discussed [france-after].
